title: 智谱、MiniMax，大砍销售开支
content: Zhipu and MiniMax simultaneously achieved significant revenue growth while reducing sales expenses in 2026. This shift marks a transition from sales-driven to product-led growth, where developers adopt models via self-service platforms due to superior capabilities rather than active persuasion. Zhipu’s revenue increasingly comes from API subscriptions, while MiniMax’s business shifted heavily to enterprise customers. The savings are strategically reallocated to R&D and infrastructure. However, reducing traditional sales introduces risks regarding post-sales support, requiring efficient service structures to retain deep-integration enterprise clients.

title: 刚写完V4.1主算子就要“转业”？DeepSeek资深算子工程师深夜独白
content: Liu Shengyu, a senior DeepSeek engineer who delivered core operators for V4.1, asserts that AI is rapidly replacing human expertise in low-level GPU optimization. He predicts AI will soon surpass top engineers in writing and optimizing code, forcing professionals to "transition" into supervisory roles managing AI agents rather than hand-coding. Liu argues that while this shift threatens traditional technical craftsmanship and engineering depth, it is an inevitable industrial evolution. He remains at DeepSeek to contribute to open-source AI, believing its development offers a counterbalance to concentrated technological power and systemic risks associated with automated, low-quality code generation.

title: 中国也认为AI可能毁灭人类，但当务之急是先赶上美国

Despite sharing concerns regarding AI’s potential to pose existential risks to humanity, Beijing’s current priority is exclusively on closing the technological gap with the US. The primary focus across Chinese government agencies and research laboratories remains strictly on accelerating development to achieve parity with American capabilities.
